title: Versioned logical input contract with generation ownership, deterministic stuck-input cleanup, right/middle mouse buttons, wheel, and relative pointer motion

commands.run_o14: adb -s emulator-5556 shell am instrument -w -e class com.pocketrealm.o14.O14InputContractTest com.pocketrealm.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner
commands.run_o06_regression: adb -s emulator-5556 shell am instrument -w -e class com.pocketrealm.client.ClientRuntimeLifecycleTest com.pocketrealm.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner

files_NOT_changed: AIDL, supervisor/database/realm/world services, Wine runtime, winlator X-server, O13 files and evidence

acceptance_observations_from_win32_probe.note: All four new input paths (right-button, middle-button, wheel, relative-motion) were observed through Android → InputContract → XServer → Wine → the project-owned Win32 self-test probe. Existing keyboard, absolute-pointer, and left-click behavior re-asserted as regression.

contract_verification.stale_rejection_note: An event stamped with generation+999 was rejected by the contract while a current-generation event was accepted; rejectedStaleEventCount incremented from 0 to 1.
contract_verification.focus_loss_note: Holding right-button + W key, then triggering focus loss, released both (1 button + 1 key) deterministically.

regression_results.O06_ClientRuntimeLifecycleTest: PASS (OK, 1 test, 31.145s) — keyboard make/break, absolute pointer transform, letterboxing, left-button tap, focus repair, graceful close, release on pause/focus loss, renderer/client restart all preserved.
regression_results.O12_IntegratedRuntimeTest: NOT RUN TO COMPLETION — the O13 soak left the emulator database in its qualified playerbots-enriched state (410 migrations, O13 runtime). The O12 integrated test's account-creation/login flow and world-revision assumptions do not match that state. This is a pre-existing database-state condition of the qualified O13 lane, NOT a regression from the O14 input-contract changes (which touch only UI-process Kotlin + the self-test PE, zero database/realm/world files). Restoring the O12 database baseline would violate the O13-preservation constraint, so the O12 regression was not forced.

remaining_gaps_after_this_increment: IME composition and committed-text path (UX-T06) — not implemented
Gamepad axes/buttons/hot-plug (FUN-009 gamepad half) — not implemented
Pointer capture / physical-mouse passthrough (FUN-009 mouse half) — not implemented
Profile persistence (on-disk) — default-only in this increment
Default touch overlay (virtual sticks / action bar, report §16.7) — not implemented
UX-T01 through UX-T08 remain NOT complete; O14 status remains pending

covered: right and middle buttons tracked and released
left button press/release preserves verified path
duplicate button press does not double-inject
unmatched button up dropped without synthesizing down
wheel emits atomic press-release and is never retained
focus loss releases all held buttons
generation replacement releases old state before accepting new
releasing one device does not release another device held state
release order and diagnostics are deterministic
aspect mismatch selects default profile and reports reset
aspect match keeps provided profile without reset
